subtopics.title: India and BRICS comparison
subtopics.summary: India ranked 116th in the 2026 report with a score of 4.536, improved from 118th. Its areas of improvement were social support and healthy life expectancy. Among BRICS nations, China ranked highest at 65th, and India ranked below Nepal and Pakistan but above Bangladesh and Sri Lanka.
facts: India improved from 118th in the previous ranking
India's areas of improvement: social support and healthy life expectancy
China ranked 65th, the highest among BRICS nations
India ranked below Nepal (99th) and Pakistan (104th)
India ranked above Bangladesh (127th) and Sri Lanka (134th)

subtopics.title: Social media and youth well-being
subtopics.summary: The 2026 report examines how social media use relates to happiness among young people. Youth aged 15 to 24 report lower life satisfaction than those aged 60 and above, a pattern seen in the United States, Canada, Australia and New Zealand. Adolescent girls using social media for more than five hours a day are the most vulnerable group, while youth using it for under one hour a day report the best well-being.
facts: Youth aged 15-24 report lower life satisfaction than elderly aged 60+
Age-based pattern observed in US, Canada, Australia and New Zealand
Most vulnerable group: adolescent girls using social media over 5 hours a day
Heavy use linked with decline in mental health and comparison-driven stress
Optimal threshold: youth using social media under 1 hour a day
Youth using under 1 hour a day report even better well-being than non-users
Digital paradox: in developing countries like India, digital access improves education and connectivity
Excessive use in the same settings causes stress and anxiety
Report provides insights into mental health and digital behaviour trends
